equation: NaCl + H2O + CO2 + NH3 -> NH4Cl + NaHCO3
explanation: Sodium chloride reacts with water, carbon dioxide and ammonia to produce sodium hydrogencarbonate (baking soda) and ammonium chloride — the industrial route from common salt to baking soda.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A colourless brine solution, with ammonia and carbon dioxide gas bubbled through.
beaker_view.final_appearance: Fine white crystals settling in an otherwise colourless solution.
beaker_view.observation: As ammonia and carbon dioxide are bubbled through the brine, fine white crystals of sodium hydrogencarbonate gradually appear and settle out.
